layers.title: Gateways and governance
layers.text: Every door into the platform and every check on the way: the ingress, sign-in, entitlements, the gateway every model and agent call passes, and the admin control plane.

layers.title: Consumption: AI, BI and GenAI
layers.text: What people use: the web app, the model and chat services one instance per scenario kind, dashboards and chat UIs.

layers.title: Data
layers.text: Where data lives and how it gets there: object storage, databases and vectors, the jobs that clean data, train models and index documents, and the optional streaming data platform.

layers.title: Infrastructure
layers.text: The cluster everything runs on: Kubernetes (k3s, or k3d on a laptop), its volumes, and an optional GPU node for local models.

layers.title: Observability
layers.text: Metrics, logs and traces of every service, plus the AI-specific monitors: a trace per LLM call and a record per training run.

components.name: Kubernetes (k3s)
components.tech: k3s · k3d on Docker for a laptop
components.role: Runs every workload as a pod in the ai-circus namespace, with requests, limits, probes and non-root containers.

components.name: GPU node
components.role: Lends the host GPU to deep-learning training, local models (vLLM) and GPU telemetry.

components.name: vLLM
components.role: Serves an open-weights LLM on the GPU behind llm-gateway, so a model can run without a cloud provider.

components.name: LLM providers
components.tech: OpenAI · Anthropic · Google · Groq · DeepSeek · Ollama
components.role: The models themselves, outside the cluster. Only llm-gateway ever calls them.

components.name: SeaweedFS
components.role: Datasets, trained models, documents, MLflow artifacts, the data platform's landing zone and Iceberg lake, every key prefixed by tenant.

components.name: PostgreSQL
components.role: Keycloak, tenants and entitlements, chat history, form submissions, Langfuse and MLflow metadata, and the data platform's bronze and marts.

components.name: Valkey
components.role: Cache: sessions, rate-limit and budget counters of llm-gateway, Langfuse's queue.

components.name: Qdrant
components.role: One vector collection per scenario and tenant: the passages RAG and form assistants search.

components.name: ClickHouse
components.role: Langfuse's trace store, and the data platform's analytical marts on the analytics tier.

components.name: etl-tabular
components.role: Cleans each tabular scenario's dataset, applies its business rules and data-quality policy, and writes the processed copy.

components.name: training
components.role: Trains every candidate, picks the model by its metric (simpler wins within a margin), writes the model, its card and out-of-fold scores.

components.name: etl-vectorize
components.role: Chunks each scenario's documents, embeds them through llm-gateway and writes them to the tenant's Qdrant collection.

components.name: dl-training
components.tech: k8s Job or host GPU · PyTorch, exported to ONNX
components.role: Fine-tunes the deep-learning scenarios (NLP, computer vision, anomaly detection) and exports ONNX models.

components.name: Kafka
components.role: The event backbone of a data product: a topic per contract and tenant, fed by its simulator and by change capture.

components.name: data-ingest
components.role: Validates every record against its contract, upserts it idempotently into bronze, quarantines what fails, archives to the Iceberg lake and keeps the live aggregates.

components.name: data-transform
components.role: Builds silver and gold from bronze with tested dbt models; the marts the dashboards and the API read.

components.name: Dagster
components.role: Orchestrates the transformations with sensors, lineage and checks on the analytics tier.

components.name: data-api
components.role: The governed door to a data product: records, search, metrics, read-only SQL and live events, filtered by tenant first, then the role's rows and masks.

components.name: OpenMetadata
components.role: The data catalogue: owners, lineage and tests of every dataset, kept in sync by a Job.

components.name: crm-api
components.role: An example business API (customers of the shops) that an MCP server is put in front of, with its own token audience.

components.name: ui-react
components.role: The web app: the scenario gallery, generic tabs driven by each scenario.yaml, the showpiece tabs, chat, voice, Settings and the admin Platform page.

components.name: prediction
components.role: Serves every tabular model: predictions with SHAP, forecasts and what-ifs, recommendations, the dataset sample and the model card, per tenant.

components.name: assistant
components.role: The chat copilot of tabular and data scenarios: answers from tools (model, data, documents, analysis toolsets), never invents a figure.

components.name: rag-agent
components.role: Answers questions grounded in a scenario's documents (RAG and GraphRAG), citing every passage, and serves them to MCP clients.

components.name: form-agent
components.role: Fills a form through conversation, validates it, prints official PDFs and tracks each submission per user.

components.name: agui-voice
components.role: Voice mode: speech to text and text to speech around the same agents, over a WebSocket.
components.enable: On with make k3s-all; the lite profile scales it to zero (make k3s-full brings it back)

components.name: dl-inference
components.role: Serves the deep-learning models (images, text, camera frames) on CPU with ONNX Runtime.

components.name: Superset
components.role: BI dashboards over a data product's marts, imported from the scenario's YAML.

components.name: Open WebUI · LibreChat
components.role: Off-the-shelf chat apps with Keycloak sign-in that reach the platform's tools only through the MCP gateway, with each user's token.

components.name: Traefik
components.role: The only way in from a browser: *.localhost hostnames to each service. The registry, gateway, Qdrant and Valkey are never exposed.

components.name: Keycloak
components.role: Sign-in and tenants: a tenant is a Keycloak Organization, a scenario is a realm role; per-API token exchange for MCP servers.

components.name: platform-registry
components.role: Tenants, scenarios and entitlements, checked by every service before it answers; the audit trail and the AI-BOM.

components.name: llm-gateway
components.role: Every model call and every MCP tool call: routing, rate limits, per-tenant budgets, the policy decision point, the local embedding model and the MCP gateway.

components.name: MCP server kit (crm-mcp)
components.role: An MCP server in front of an existing API: validates the token, applies the tool policy, exchanges the token for the API's own, writes an audit line per call.

components.name: Open Policy Agent
components.role: An optional policy decision point the gateway can ask before a model call, with the policy as code.

components.name: data-platform-manager
components.role: The admin control plane behind the Platform page: health, resources, start and stop of optional workloads, the capability roadmap and governance switches.

components.name: Langfuse
components.role: A trace per LLM call by tenant, scenario and conversation, fed only by llm-gateway.

components.name: MLflow
components.role: Every training run's candidates, scores and the selected model; never allowed to fail a training job.

components.name: OpenTelemetry collector
components.role: Receives every service's traces and logs over OTLP, masks tokens and emails in log lines, forwards them.

components.name: VictoriaMetrics
components.role: Scrapes every service's /metrics and evaluates the alert rules.

components.name: Loki
components.role: Stores the JSON log lines, each with its trace id.

components.name: Tempo
components.role: Stores the content-free traces, including one trace across the MCP hop.

components.name: Grafana
components.role: Dashboards for the LLM gateway (calls, tokens, cost, latency), GPUs, model drift and the MCP path.
